Culla
ins. poet. an. privy councillor of Arthapati Bhaṭṭāraka of the family of King Nala; drafted the Kesaribeda Plate of the king. See Epi. Ind.
; Bhand. Ins. of N. I. no. 1876.

Cullakappasuya
Ukkāliya sutta ref. to in Nandī (s. 44); explanation of Kalpa.
See Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas p.. 26. 102.

Cullagandhavaṃsa
See Gandhavam3sa, NCC. V. p. 308b.

On the Adyar ms. see Adyar Library Bulletin XI. iii. p.. 34-35.

Cullanirutti
or Cullaniruttigandha. one of the oldest Pāli gr. ascribed to Mahākaccāyana, a. of the Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa.
See Gandhavam3sa 59 (

Cūlānirutti
Pāli. gr. Colombo p. 55. See Cūlanirutti above.

Cullanirutti(abhinava)
Bud. Pāli. gr. by Siri Saddharmābhilaṅkāra Thera. Colombo D.

Cullabuddha
or culla(cUla)vajira(buddhi) or cullavimalabuddhi
--Atthavyākhyāna. Bud. Pāli. gr.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 101a. [Page067-b]

Cullavedallasutta

Pt.. with Sinhalese transl. Colombo, 1897. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 707.

Cullikābhaṭṭavṛtti
Q. by Rāyamukuṭa on Amara.

Cullibhaṭṭi
a. of a Vṛtti on a.gr. work. q. in Tantrapradīpa etc.
See Intro. p. 1 to edn. of Dhātupradīpa (of Maitreyarakṣita), Savitārāya Smṛtirakṣaṇa Granthamālā, 2, Varendra Research Society, Rajshahi, 1919.

.). of Suttapiṭaka. Br. Mus. Pāli p. 139. Colombo D.

Cūlagaṇa
one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 105.

Cūlagaṇṭhipada
Bud. Vinaya text. attributed to Moggallāna. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p.. 75. 76.

Cūlaniddesa_Aṭṭhakathā
one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 104. p. 411.

Cūlamaṇisāra
one of the works mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 108.

Bud. Pāli. Siamese chronicle composed by Vanaratana during the reign of Rāma I.
Pt.. Pāli Text with Siamese version. Bangkok, 1920. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1167.

Cūlarūpasiddhi
Bud. Pāli. gr. Colombo D.

Cūlavaṃsa
Bud. Pāli chronicle of Ceylon upto 1815 A. D.; continuation of Mahāvam3sa by Dhammakītti an. others.
See Malalasekhara, Dictionary of Pāli Proper Names Vol. I. p. 901. [Page072-a.
Pt.. PTS. in Roman script. 2 Vol.. 1923. 1927.
